title: Settle into native radical geometry
summary: Added a 0.89-0.95 native settlement window that cross-reconciles complete hook and overbar fragments with the native KaTeX radical at identical measured geometry, then removes temporary fragment owners before release.

sourceRefs.summary: Samples fragment release and native radical acquisition on one smooth settlement progress.
Proves the midpoint handoff retains both fragment owners, native opacity is partial, total material visibility remains one, and endpoint cleanup is exact.
